news.title: Teen arrested on charges connected to deadly 404 Day shooting bonds out

news.title: Pedestrian hit on I-75/85 northbound near I-20 in Atlanta
news.summary: A man was rushed to the hospital Monday after getting hit by a vehicle while attempting to walk across I-75/85 northbound near the I-20 exit, police said.

news.summary: As a new school year kicks off, the Atlanta Public Schools district is investing more into school safety.

news.title: MLB trade deadline: Atlanta Braves roster moves so far
news.summary: The countdown for Major League Baseball’s trade deadline is coming down to the wire. Teams have until 6 p.m. Monday to make their final trades for the season.

news.title: 17-year-old suspect surrenders in deadly '404 Day' shooting, later released on bond: APD

news.summary: Police are investigating a shooting Sunday that left one person injured in a parking lot in DeKalb County.

news.title: Man killed, suspect charged with murder in Hwy 78 road rage shooting
news.summary: A 54-year-old man is in custody after a deadly shooting on Stone Mountain Freeway (Hwy 78) on Saturday afternoon, according to DeKalb County Police Department.
